tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Ink Navy — the core brand colour. Header, footer, headings and body text on surface, pale-blue, teal-50, coral-50 and yellow-50 (12:1+). Fill for dark panels, with text-inverse on it.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for navy fills (header links, inverse buttons); text-inverse on it 16:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Brand Teal. Graphic use only: illustrations, icon badges, brand pattern, dividers, the children-and-young-people accent. 3.0:1 on white — never text or a button fill behind white text; navy text on it is 4.7:1.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Accessible teal. Primary button fill (text-inverse on it 6.3:1), links, success text, active states; as text on surface, pale-blue and teal-50 (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: teal-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of teal-700 fills and links (8.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind teal-700 or navy text: success states, children-and-young-people cards, selected cards.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand Yellow — the sun. Illustration, icon badges, pattern, the schools accent and the focus state (navy text on it 9.2:1). Never text on white (1.5:1).

tokens.name: yellow-800
tokens.usage: Accessible ochre for text tied to the schools accent, on surface and yellow-50 (5.8:1+).

tokens.name: yellow-50
tokens.usage: Tint for advice panels ("Need advice?") and schools cards; navy or text-secondary on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand Coral. Graphic use only: illustration, icon badges, pattern, the parents-and-carers accent, the help/alert icon disc. 3.0:1 on white — never small text.

tokens.name: coral-700
tokens.usage: Accessible coral for carer-accent text and links on surface and coral-50 (5.0:1+); fill behind text-inverse (5.7:1) for emergency banners.

tokens.name: coral-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind coral-700 or navy text: carers cards, help panels.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Soft Purple — the fifth brand colour, added for the social workers audience. Graphic use only: icon badges, accent shapes. 2.9:1 on white — never text; navy text on it is 4.9:1.

tokens.name: purple-700
tokens.usage: Accessible purple for social-worker accent text and links on surface and purple-50 (6.7:1+); fill behind text-inverse (7.7:1).

tokens.name: purple-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind purple-700 or navy text: social workers cards and panels.

tokens.name: pale-blue
tokens.usage: Brand Pale Blue. Section and panel backgrounds, feature cards, hero ground. navy (12.6:1), text-secondary (6.3:1) and teal-700 (5.6:1) read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card fill.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate background for table stripes, input add-ons and filter panels.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-alt, pale-blue and every -50 tint.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Hints, metadata, card descriptions on surface, pale-blue and the -50 tints (6.1:1+).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy, navy-900, teal-700, teal-800, coral-700 and error fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card outlines, table rules, dividers. Not for control boundaries (1.5:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and radio boundaries and any border that carries meaning (5.1:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on pale-blue).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on surface, pale-blue and tints.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links in body content (10:1 on white), as GOV.UK does.

tokens.name: link-inverse
tokens.usage: Links on navy (header, footer, CTA banners).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus background — GOV.UK pattern: yellow fill with a navy 4px underline (focus-text). Solid on every surface.

tokens.name: focus-text
tokens.usage: Text and the underline bar on a focused element.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error messages, error borders and the error summary outline (6.6:1 on white); fill behind text-inverse.

tokens.name: error-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind error text in error states.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and confirmation panel fill — teal, off the red–green axis, so it differs from error by hue and by an icon.

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind success messages.
